For FNS_SUBSCRIBER_OPEN_INTEGRATION the parser/status envelope must explicitly distinguish source-visible special statuses, structurally proven clean-active absence only where the visible structure makes that conclusion safe, visibility-restricted/possibly-hidden reorganization/special state, final termination and unknown/incomplete semantics; ambiguity that can hide a special state fails closed to unknown/reviewable for later policy rather than false clean ACTIVE.
